posts.text:
When I built Trading Venture Club, I had a choice:

Option A: Only show winning trades. Screenshot the best results. Scale fast.

Option B: Show everything. Every win. Every loss. Every stopped-out trade.

I chose B.

The crypto signal industry is built on survivorship bias. Channels that only show wins attract short-term subscribers who churn the moment reality hits.

Channels that show the full picture attract people who understand how trading actually works. Those people stay.

Our real record: 31 trades, 48.4% win rate, $+72 PnL. Not every trade wins. That's exactly why the track record is credible.

Ask anyone selling you signals: "Can I see your full, unedited trade history?"


#Transparency #CryptoSignals #TradingVentureClub
